summary: Re-review confirms the single prior REJECT finding is genuinely fixed and no new divergence was introduced. server/src/external/tasks/create.ts:161-182 now reads body.runtime (narrowed body.runtime === "codex" ? "codex" : undefined, matching the existing narrowing idiom in sdk-sessions-store.ts:436 / triage.ts:318) and passes it into store.create({...}); the new regression file server/src/external/tasks/__tests__/routes.create-runtime.test.ts posts to the real HTTP route (not a direct store call) and covers all three cases (codex passthrough, omitted->claude default, garbage value->claude fallback, i.e. narrowed not passed-through-raw). Client side of the same chokepoint verified too: useNewIssueFormSubmit.ts's createPayload sends runtime: input.runtime in the POST /api/external/tasks body, so the previously-silent drop is closed end-to-end (client sends it, server now reads it, store persists it). Fresh spot-check across the other 8 ACs found nothing that reopens the fixed finding or surfaces a new one: RuntimeToggle wiring on all three modals (AC1/AC3/§3.5), runtime-chokepoint.ts (AC2/AC4/AC7/AC9), fork inheritance + regression test (§2.1 correction), sdk-sessions-validate.ts backfill + regression test (old record without runtime), triage promote's narrower global-default-only scope (§3.5), and the AC8 readiness OR-gate mirrored in both readiness-probe.ts and bootstrapper/lib/preflight.mjs. Full server test suite reported green (4253 passed / 12 skipped / 0 failed) and tsc --noEmit clean per the implementer's report. Stage 2 (code-reviewer) may proceed.
